description.text:
An empathy-aligned conversational support model fine-tuned from Llama 3.1 8B Instruct using a two-stage alignment pipeline: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on 36K counseling examples followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on ~2K preference-filtered pairs.

Disclaimer: This is an AI research project and is not a substitute for professional mental health care. If you are in crisis, please contact the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (call or text 988) or your local emergency services.

output_type.quote: An empathy-aligned conversational support model fine-tuned from Llama 3.1 8B Instruct using a two-stage alignment pipeline.

use_claim.quote: You are a mental health counselor providing supportive, empathetic guidance.

warning.quote: This is an AI research project and is not a substitute for professional mental health care.

serving.text_only_input_quote: {"role": "user", "content": "I've been feeling really anxious about work lately and I can't sleep."}
serving.system_prompt: You are a mental health counselor providing supportive, empathetic guidance. Respond by first acknowledging the person's feelings, then explore their situation with open-ended questions. Use techniques like reflective listening, validation, and gentle reframing. Keep responses warm, conversational, and non-judgmental.
serving.notes: config.json max_position_embeddings is 131072. The card's generate() example uses max_new_tokens 512, temperature 0.7, top_p 0.9, repetition_penalty 1.1. GitHub SFT and DPO configs set max_length 2048. The training system prompt in configs/sft_config.yaml adds a crisis-helpline sentence that the card example omits. Root weights are the merged model; sft/ and dpo/ are separate LoRA adapters (r=64/alpha=128 and r=16/alpha=32). JSON rank, alpha, learning rate, epochs, and batch size are the DPO stage. SFT stage: rank 64, alpha 128, learning rate 2e-4, 2 epochs, effective batch size 16.

evaluation_reported.text: Evaluated on 25 curated prompts across 18 mental health categories. Perplexity: base 4.18, SFT 3.64, DPO 3.13. GPT-4o judge overall (1-5): base 4.35, SFT 3.52, DPO 4.71.

discrepancies: The inventory names match the card. Separate from the inventory: a LinkedIn post by the author says SFT on 40k examples; the card and prepare_sft_data.py say about 36K. The GitHub code license is MIT; the model card license is Apache 2.0. The old dataset id Psychotherapy-LLM/PsychoCounsel-Preference redirects to Psychotherapy-LLM/PsyCoPref.
